name: BIANCA GISMONTI & MANUEL DE OLIVEIRA
description: Experience a fusion of Brazilian jazz piano and Portuguese guitar in a beautiful outdoor setting as part of Festival das Artes QuebraJazz.
longDescription:
On July 17, 2026, Bianca Gismonti and Manuel de Oliveira will perform at Colina De Camões as part of the Festival das Artes QuebraJazz. Bianca Gismonti, a Brazilian jazz pianist and composer, is known for her contemporary interpretations and original compositions. Manuel de Oliveira is a Portuguese guitarist whose work often incorporates traditional Portuguese sounds with contemporary influences. This concert brings together their distinct musical styles for a collaborative performance.

Attendees will experience an evening concert in an outdoor setting. The performance is part of a larger arts festival, suggesting a relaxed and culturally engaged atmosphere. The Colina De Camões provides a natural backdrop for the music. The duration of the concert will be typical for a live music event.

Tickets for this event are available through the Festival das Artes QuebraJazz website. Colina De Camões is accessible by public transport; it is within walking distance of several bus stops. Specific metro or tram connections would depend on the exact location within Porto.
